The 720-day history included a strong uptrend, and on it 0 of 21 configurations passed the gate. Five independent measurements agreed that a passive wide range is about HODL plus fees minus a little IL. Narrowing added variance without adding expectancy at the observed flat-episode lengths (median 7.7 days). The journal adds that the up regime was systematically the worst (0–25% wins) across all variants, and the up→5050 fallback improved averages but not the tail.

Produkt FlatWide: flat POTWIERDZONY (|gap|<2% ≥12h) — zwężenie z ±40% do ±5%: stała szerokość produktu ±5% (1.0× próg wyjścia).
Powrót do szerokiego zaproponuję przy |gap|>5%.

perQuestion.answer: FLAT_NARROW is neither a fixed position nor a standalone range algorithm. It is a kind of proposal (action) that the bot issues for an existing position (identified by tokenId), part of the "FlatWide" product. Once a flat is confirmed (|gap|<2% for ≥12h), it suggests narrowing the range from ±40% or ±50% to a fixed ±5% width, with a cost and payback estimate. It then proposes returning to the wide range when |gap|>5%. Each proposal carries a specific suggestedRange (ticks and USD bounds) for that position, so the range is computed per proposal by the product's rule.
